title: Larry C. Perojo | Obituaries | timesargus.com
text:
Larry C. Perojo BARRE — Larry C. Perojo, 71, of Barre, passed away on Saturday, June 27, 2026, at CVMC in Berlin. Calling hours will be held for Larry on July 18, 2026, from 11am to 1pm, at Pruneau-Polli Funeral Home in Barre. To view the full obituary, please visit www.pruneaupollifuneralhome.com
